svg.aria-label: RX eye scan, log10 BER against horizontal and vertical offset
svg.text: RX eye scan, 10.3125 Gb/s, DFE, after the equaliser
log10 BER per point (white: BER below 1e-12 or no errors seen; black: BER about 0.3). Bold line: BER 1e-09. Dot: no errors seen, value is the 3/bits bound.
vertical offset (mV, nominal: 1.5 mV per code)
At BER 1e-09: width 0.750 UI (+/-0.031 grid), height 288 mV (+/-12 grid). Equaliser DFE; 2046 points.
